name: Kijou Mami
source:
[url=/c64091]Masaharu's[/url] sister. She likes to wake her brother up with a morning blowjob every day and frequently tries to convince him to commit incest. On her route she becomes [url=/c45012]Magical Mamirin[/url]. Uses her position as a new magical girl to trick her brother into raw baby making sex until he admits he likes it.

[spoiler]She knows [url=/c64095]Enbi-fuku Kamen[/url] and [url=/c64092]Mesu-dorei A-ko[/url] are her parents but doesn't bother telling Masaharu.[/spoiler]
